title: DF7 Gas Dryer
sub: Matte black, gas, 7.0 cu. ft., front controls
lead: The DF7 is the dryer that stands beside Speed Queen's FF7 front load washer, in matte black. Its controls are on the front, at the washer's height. Ten cycles, steam three ways, Pet Plus cycles, and a moisture sensor that stops the heat when the load is dry.

features.name: Steam, three ways
features.line: Steam Boost works on wrinkles and static, Steam Refresh freshens what was worn once, and Steam Sanitize is there for the loads that need more.

features.name: Dries to the sensor, not the clock
features.line: Four auto dry cycles follow a moisture sensor and end when the load is dry, which Speed Queen calls Over-dry Protection. An Eco Dry option is on the panel.

features.name: Pet Plus cycles
features.line: Cycles made for pet bedding and blankets, with one for removing pet hair.

features.name: Controls on the front
features.line: Ten cycles and four temperatures on a front panel with a time-remaining display. At 40 7/16 inches tall, it lines up with the FF7 washer beside it.

features.name: Five years, parts and labor
features.line: Speed Queen backs the DF7 with a 5-year warranty that covers parts and labor.

also: 22,500 BTU gas burner; converts to LP with Speed Queen's kit, sold separately
Extended Tumble, which keeps the load moving after the cycle ends
A matching 8-inch riser pedestal is made for it, sold separately
